summary: Virtuix Holdings Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) registering the resale of up to 25,307,961 shares of Class A common stock by selling stockholders. This is a routine shelf takedown or resale registration, not a special situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate event is announced. The filing updates the existing prospectus dated May 14, 2026. The registrant is the issuer filing a registration statement for secondary resales. There are no deal terms, premiums, or structural changes. The filing is a standard equity registration without any special-situation catalyst.
